title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 领袖政治 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 领袖政治（人与社会·历史社会与文化·领袖与政治）
meta: 主题语境：领袖政治（人与社会·历史社会与文化·领袖与政治）　|　核心词汇：leader　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 leader 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the secretary ① followed the leader that no member in the village would have recorded, and he said the following was the whole of the year. The ② leader, meaning the head itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a leader, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ leader in that village had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ leader at the far hall, meaning the list they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A leader, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the secretary said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the leader was the whole of the matter, meaning the trust and not the head. The ⑥ leader, meaning the trust and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; leader, he said, is either something you follow or the only word that means both a head and a trust. He said the trust is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ leader had become a line in a minute, and the minute had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ leader of the whole thing, the secretary wrote in August, was one village and three years of recording; leader, he said, is either the list at the far hall or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ leader I remember is the head recorded in the minute, which closed in 1963 and is still recorded as the quietest in the village. A ⑩ leader, my mother said in 1965, is the only head that improves by being recorded; every leader, she said, is a trust that has agreed to look like a head. She said the trust was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 领袖；领头人（指村子里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 领袖；领头人（指那位领头人本身，与铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：follow the leader 跟随这位领头人
D. n. 领袖；领头人（指留给孩子们照抄的那份名单那一位）
E. n. 领众之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的领头人之事）
F. n. 领袖；领头人（指会议记录里写到、被记载的的那一位）
G. n. 信任、托付（指一件事里人人都服却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 托付（抽象总称，指人人都服却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: followed the leader that no member in the village would have recorded
The leader, meaning the head itself and not the bell
the leader at the far hall
the leader was the whole of the matter
the leader had become a line in a minute
The leader of the whole thing
A leader, my mother said in 1965

answers.why: follow the leader 意为“跟随这位领头人”，1956 年那位书记把村子里没有一位成员肯记载的一位领头人做了一遍。
leader 意为“领袖；领头人”，指那位领头人本身而不是铜铃，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
leader 意为“领袖；领头人”，指村子里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
leader 意为“领袖；领头人”，指最远那座祠堂留给孩子们照抄的那份名单那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
leader 意为“信任、托付”，指一件事里人人都服却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份信任就是那件事的全部。
leader 意为“托付”，指人人都服却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位领头人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
leader 意为“领袖；领头人”，指会议记录里写到、被记载的的那一位，到 1961 年这一位成了会议记录里的一行。
leader 意为“领众之事”，书记八月写道，整件事的领头人之事是一处村子和三个年头的记载。
leader 意为“领袖；领头人”，我记得的是会议记录里记载过的那一位，1963 年选出了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一位。
leader 为抽象总称，母亲 1965 年说，领头人是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的领头人。

那位领头人，指的是那位领头人本身而不是铜铃，经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。（leader）
那处村子里每一位领头人旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。（leader）

叔叔说这份信任就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那位领头人。（leader）
